title: Study Portal JSON Catalog — Research and Usage Notes

schema.topic: Human-readable topic, discipline, product, role, or pathway.
schema.skills: Normalized skills useful for search, filtering, role mapping, and MapIT taxonomy.

url_type.topic_page: Stable topic or tutorial landing page.
url_type.catalog_filter: Official catalog pre-filtered to the topic.
url_type.catalog_search: Official catalog search for a dynamic platform.
url_type.login_dependent_catalog: The provider requires login and does not expose stable public item URLs.
url_type.platform_entry: Main platform link where the search term should be used.

schema.access: Broad access model; actual regional price or eligibility may change.

important_limitations: Coursera, edX, LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft Learn, AWS Skill Builder, Google Cloud Skills Boost, SWAYAM, and NPTEL change frequently.
The files index major topic areas and stable discovery routes instead of attempting to snapshot every individual course.
Infosys Springboard and CISA Learning require registration and do not expose reliable public deep links for every course.
FedVTE has been replaced by CISA Learning; the FedVTE file therefore maps current successor resources.
Some course availability, pricing, language, certification, and eligibility details are region-dependent.
